svg.text: drawn by edakit schematic draw – change the graph, not this drawing
Push-in terminal for the wires from the 5 V supply: they can be
ADLSC's symbol numbers J3 from CLK (20) to GND (38); the EasyEDA
symbol of C20437001 from GND (20) to CLK (38) – the pins are written
in the latter. 3V3, IO5, IO18, IO19, IO21, IO22, IO23 go only to the
Pmod positions J2/J5 and R4, R6, R7, R9, R13, R17, which the schematic
Gates C and D unused: inputs 3A, 4A and enables to GND, outputs 3Y, 4Y
